seo.title: TablePro for teams
seo.description: Share connections and saved queries with your team, never their passwords. Priced per seat, monthly or yearly, with an invoice for your company.

header.title: TablePro for teams
header.lead: Share connections and saved queries with your team, never their passwords. Every seat gets Pro, and your company gets an invoice.

items.name: Up to {deviceLimit} computers
items.text: One person, on Mac or Linux.

items.name: Team Library
items.text: Admins publish connections and saved queries, and every member finds them in the sidebar.

items.name: Team Catalog
items.text: Password-free connection files in a folder your team already shares, such as a Git repository.

price.title: Price
price.note: Team is a subscription. There is no one-time Team license.

rows.text: Owners and admins invite people by email, with a role and a seat. The link works for {inviteDays} days.
The owner pays. Admins manage members and the Team Library. Members use what is shared.
The owner adds or removes seats in Billing, and {merchant} charges or credits the difference at once.
Their seat is free at once. Team stops on their computers at the next license check.
{merchant} takes the payment and adds sales tax or VAT for your billing address.
Add your company name and VAT number in {merchant}'s portal, then download each invoice.
Within {refundDays} days of a purchase, and of each renewal.
Or another way to pay: write to <email>{email}</email>.
Never sent. The app removes them before publishing, and the server refuses anything that holds one.
The Team Library is kept on TablePro's server, and only computers activated on your license can read it.
What was published stays until the owner deletes the team.

enterprise.title: Enterprise
enterprise.sentence: Need single sign-on, your own terms or a larger rollout? Tell us what your company needs.
